title: Drafting thank you letters to donors on Mac: a guide for nonprofit fundraisers
metaTitle: Drafting thank you letters to donors on Mac: a guide for nonprofit fundraisers
description: Learn how to improve your drafting thank you letters to donors process on Mac to save time and increase your impact on your nonprofit mission.
targetKeyword: drafting thank you letters to donors
intro: Drafting thank you letters to donors is a central task in your role as a nonprofit fundraiser. It is the bridge between a gift and a lasting relationship, but it often consumes more time than it should.
tldr: Personalized donor communication is vital but often suffers from manual data entry and fragmented tools.
The admin tax of copying donor details into emails wastes hours every week.
You can fix your workflow by centralizing data and using voice-to-text to speed up your drafting process.
Lazur helps by letting you dictate your thoughts directly into your donor management software or email client.

blocks.text: Why drafting thank you letters to donors takes so long

You likely manage a portfolio of hundreds of donors. When you sit down to write a personal note, you have to look up their history, confirm the gift amount, and then draft something that feels authentic. If you are doing this manually in Gmail or your CRM, the process is slow. You switch between tabs, copy and paste names, and worry about typos. This is where the admin tax hits hardest.
The hidden costs of manual communication

The main cost is not just the time you spend writing. It is the opportunity cost of what you are not doing. While you spend 30 minutes on one letter, you could be calling a major donor or planning your next campaign. When your communication is slow, your donor stewardship suffers. Donors notice when a letter feels like a form template, but you lack the time to make every single one unique.

items: Platform sprawl: Your donor data lives in a CRM, but your letters are sent from Gmail or Outlook.
Manual data entry: Copying and pasting donor names and gift amounts between apps creates friction.
Context switching: Jumping between your spreadsheet, your CRM, and your email client breaks your focus.
Lack of templates: Starting from a blank page every time forces you to reinvent the wheel.

blocks.text: You do not need expensive software to improve your speed. Start by creating a library of snippets in a simple text file. Use the built-in text replacement feature on your Mac. Go to System Settings > Keyboard > Text Replacements. Add your common phrases like 'Thank you for your generous gift to our annual campaign' and assign them a shortcut like 'tyg'. When you type 'tyg', your Mac expands it to the full sentence.
If you handle sensitive donor data, always check your organization's policy on where you can store or process that information. Keep your data secure and follow your employer rules.
blocks.title: Security note

blocks.text: How Lazur helps with your drafting

Lazur is a voice assistant that lives in your Mac notch. It is built to help you finish your work without leaving the app you are currently using. When you need to draft a thank you letter, you do not have to type it out. You can hold the fn key and dictate your thoughts directly into your email body. Lazur cleans up your speech, fixes the formatting, and types it at your cursor.
A simple weekly plan for fundraisers

items: Monday Morning: Review the donor list from the past week. Use a spreadsheet to flag high-priority donors for personal notes.
Tuesday Afternoon: Dedicate one hour to batch-drafting your thank you letters. Use your saved snippets to fill in the basics.
Wednesday Morning: Review and send the letters. Check your CRM to ensure every interaction is logged.
Thursday Afternoon: Spend 30 minutes on follow-up tasks or scheduling your next donor meetings.
Friday Morning: Analyze your open rates and responses to see what messaging worked best.

faq.question: Does Lazur work with my CRM?
faq.answer: Lazur works as a system-wide voice assistant on your Mac. You can use it to dictate text into any application, including your browser-based CRM like Salesforce or Bloomerang.

faq.question: Is my donor data safe?
faq.answer: Lazur processes your voice and screen data only while you hold the activation key. It does not store your content or use it to train AI models.
